GUIDE: Clear cookies quickly

Clearing cookies is a common problem-solving technique when the browser is awry. Use CTRL + SHIFT + DEL shortcut to clear browser history and cache, generally for the last hour.

On the frontside, the issue may resolve. Behind the scenes, the browser is clearing temporarily stored files, references, and objects from the application tab in the dev tools.
Go to <GUIDE: Dev Application> to learn more.
